It also provides functionality for Prophecies missions. This template can quickly replace existing reward templates by: # Changing the name of the template from the previous one # Specifying the campaign immediately after the name # Adding Reputation type awarded, and any unusual values for skill points gold etc. # Adding any special notes underneath (such as on the Augury Rock and Divinity Coast mission examples below). {| | width=800px | 
{{Mission rewards|
| Objective = Bonus Objective for mission
| Reputation = Allegance for mission 
| ObjNMstd = Bonus Objective requirements in Normal mode to receive Standard Reward
| ObjNMexp = Bonus Objective requirements in Normal mode to receive Expert's Reward
| ObjNMmstr = Bonus Objective requirements in Normal mode to receive Master's Reward
| ObjHMstd = Bonus Objective requirements in Hard mode to receive Standard Reward 
| ObjHMexp = Bonus Objective requirements in Hard mode to receive Expert's Reward
| ObjHMmstr = Bonus Objective requirements in Hard mode to receive Master's Reward
| XPNMstd = Experience Given for Standard Reward after completion in Normal mode
| XPNMRFstd = Experience Given for Standard Reward after completion in Normal mode in Reforged Mode
| XPNMexp = Experience Given for Expert's Reward after completion in Normal mode
| XPNMmstr = Experience Given for Master's Reward after completion in Normal mode
| XPHMstd = Experience Given for Standard Reward after completion in Hard mode
| XPHMexp = Experience Given for Expert's Reward after completion in Hard mode
| XPHMmstr = Experience Given for Master's Reward after completion in Hard mode
| GoldNMstd = Gold Given for Standard Reward after completion in Normal mode
| GoldNMexp = Gold Given for Expert's Reward after completion in Normal mode
| GoldNMmstr = Gold Given for Master's Reward after completion in Normal mode
| GoldHMstd = Gold Given for Standard Reward after completion in Hard mode
| GoldHMexp = Gold Given for Expert's Reward after completion in Hard mode
| GoldHMmstr = Gold Given for Master's Reward after completion in Hard mode
| PtsNMstd = Reputation Points Given for Standard Reward after completion in Normal mode
| PtsNMexp = Reputation Points Given for Expert's Reward after completion in Normal mode
| PtsNMmstr = Reputation Points Given for Master's Reward after completion in Normal mode
| PtsHMstd = Reputation Points Given for Standard Reward after completion in Hard mode
| PtsHMexp = Reputation Points Given for Expert's Reward after completion in Hard mode
| PtsHMmstr = Reputation Points Given for Master's Reward after completion in Hard mode
}}
